resources.string: This action is no longer eligible.
The selected BedJet changed. Try again.
This action belongs to an older night. Open Nocturne for current controls.
Choose a BedJet in setup first.
Saved slot originals are unreadable. Restore a backup of this BedJet\'s slot before writing it.
The wake-up change did not finish.
The BedJet state is unknown. Check it before continuing. %1$s
Nocturne could not confirm the change. Check the BedJet before continuing.
This request waited too long. Try again.
Tracking a manual run. Alarm changes will not restart the night.
Changes applied to %1$s. Waking you at %2$s.
Your alarm changed, so tonight’s BedJet plan now wakes you at %1$s instead of %2$s.
We sent Off but your BedJet hasn\'t confirmed it. Check the BedJet, then send Off again or stop tracking.
Sent — waiting for your BedJet to confirm: %1$s
Boost: Turbo, then Heat, for %1$d min.
Stopped tracking. This does not turn the BedJet off.
Resumed the rest of %1$s. Waking you at %2$s.
The resume offer has expired or a newer command replaced it.
Check the BedJet programme, or stop tracking. No programme was restarted.
A fresh status differs from tonight’s programme. Keep tracking the current run, or stop tracking.
Choose a slot other than the working slot.
A programme is running. Stop it before changing a saved slot.
Saved in slot %1$d. Readback verified. This duration-based programme does not follow an alarm.
No original was saved for this slot.
A step in this saved original has a temperature its mode doesn\'t allow, so it wasn\'t sent to the BedJet.
This action needs a BedJet confirmation check before it can end a night.
Original restored to slot %1$d. Readback verified.
Stop tracking the current night before changing the BedJet or demo mode.
Forgot this BedJet. Choose a BedJet to connect to.
The BedJet must be idle for the supervised fan check.
Fan setting changed and restored. No mode was started.
Your BedJet didn\'t report the fan change, so fan control isn\'t confirmed. Its fan setting is back as it was.
We sent the fan setting back, but your BedJet hasn\'t confirmed it. Check its fan setting on the BedJet.
A command is in progress. Try again when it finishes.
Released for another phone. Status changes cannot be detected while disconnected.
Connected and checked the current BedJet status.
Connected. Your BedJet isn\'t running tonight\'s night as tracked, so its state is now unknown. Keep tracking the current run, or stop tracking.
Wake-up change pending. Nocturne will try again in about 10 minutes or when you open the app.
The confirmed wake-up boundary passed before the change could be applied. The BedJet was not restarted.
An operation was interrupted. The BedJet state is unknown; check it before continuing.
Allow Bluetooth connection permission, then try again.
Send this command to your BedJet?
Run %1$s? This can replace the programme currently running on the BedJet.
Resume the rest of the night
Selected the BedJet remembered by the previous version.
Open Nocturne to confirm replacing the running night.
Could not open the diagnostics file.
End the night or stop tracking before restoring a slot.
Following the alarm or profile wake time again. The wake time is unchanged.
Shown while your BedJet is waking you, with snooze and extend buttons.
Shown briefly while a command is sent.
When your wake-up moves with your alarm, when something didn\'t work, and new versions.
Your BedJet is getting you ready to wake up.
Tap to open the release and download it.
The selected BedJet changed. Check the saved slot before restoring.
The saved original changed. Check the slot before restoring.
The BedJet did not answer in time. Check its state before trying again.
Tonight\'s night changed. Check it before setting a wake time.
Backup restored. What you had before is saved as a snapshot.
Could not look for BedJets. Check Nearby devices permission.
No release found. A private repository needs a token in Settings.
Nocturne couldn\'t finish writing a restore. Until it can, changes to profiles, settings, history and saved originals aren\'t saved. Free some storage space, then reopen Nocturne.
The unreadable saved originals haven\'t been set aside yet. Reopen Nocturne, then try again.
Couldn\'t lift the block on slots with no saved original.
Couldn\'t open the file to save to.
The change is kept, but not every file could be written yet. Nocturne finishes it before your next change, or when it next starts.
An earlier change couldn\'t be finished, so this one wasn\'t saved. Try again, or reopen Nocturne.
Restored. What you had before is saved as a snapshot.
No BedJet chosen yet. Choose yours in Setup.
